verdict.rationale: Jan's docs say you can click Import Model and select your GGUF files [jan-docs-10]. Its local inference and API server are powered by llama.cpp [jan-docs-6], and it can download and run models from Hugging Face, including by entering a model's Hugging Face ID [jan-gh-1, jan-docs-11]. Together this clearly covers loading and running GGUF models. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of GGUF loading, and detailed docs on choosing quantization variants or GGUF-specific load settings.
